This is the mutant 04-REVIEW measured SURVIVING: with immediate writes both tasks commit in arrival order regardless, so the old test's final-value assertions held without the mechanism. the tab-removal listener is not registered at all, so the per-tab state map grows for the life of the worker across every tab the browser ever closes. That half is a shape guard and not a behavioural one: the map has no external observable and exposing one would move a shipped byte, so this does NOT demonstrate bounded growth at runtime (04-REVIEW WR-06, T-04G-34)
